style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

caption: The I-Ching’s eight trigrams are patterns of three solid or broken lines. Earlier Heaven places opposite patterns across from each other; Later Heaven links directions and seasons. sixlines.day

pages.a:
THE BOOK HAS EIGHT TRIGRAMS.
EACH HAS THREE LINES:
SOLID OR BROKEN.

BY TRADITION:
FU XI: EARLIER HEAVEN 先天.
KING WEN: LATER HEAVEN 後天.

FACING PAIRS DIFFER
IN ALL THREE LINES.
HEAVEN 天: ALL SOLID.
EARTH 地: ALL BROKEN.

LINKS DIRECTIONS AND SEASONS.
THUNDER 雷: EAST AND SPRING.

SAME EIGHT TRIGRAMS.
EARLIER HEAVEN: OPPOSITE PAIRS.
LATER HEAVEN: SEASONS.
